Contains the ONLY known Katabagan language data: four words remembered by elders, from the community's ancestral-domain application (title R04-CAT-1115-191, granted 2015): duyaan 'many', games 'rain', gumaak 'tomorrow', pataun 'to go', compared with Inagta Alabat and Manide (p. 3). sources.note: Nothing; states that no linguistic data of any kind exists: 'a visit to the group in 2006 confirmed that none of the Katabangan speak any language natively other than Tagalog, nor is there any recollection of their ancestors speaking any other language.
